candidates.title: 規劃 feedback lesson promotion 或 downgrade
candidates.summary: feedback/promotion 描述 lesson promotion 的 durable target selection；可執行 lesson 寫作規則仍由 enforcement/feedback-lessons.md 管理。

candidates.title: Evidence Chain Validation
candidates.summary: Evidence chain validation 是一種 validation reasoning pattern：驗證必須沿著狀態傳播鏈一路追到最終可觀察結果，並在每個重要 state transition 上附上足夠證據。

candidates.title: Identity-Coupled Side Effect Validation
candidates.summary: Identity-coupled side effect validation 是 [`evidence-chain-validation.md`](evidence-chain-validation.md) 的特化案例：產品行為同時依賴呼叫者身份狀態，並產生可觀察 side effect。

candidates.title: 維護 active goal 與 durable roadmap goal 邊界
candidates.summary: active goal 刪除條件與 durable follow-up gate 由 conversation-goal-ledger 定義。

candidates.title: 2026-10-23 - Seated interface-analysis: UnityPy batch + honest splash stub + commit per segment
candidates.summary: 裝置已進桌時，先做進桌 §3e（UnityCache UnityPy 盤點＋粒子參數＋L0–L7 map＋遮罩 live），splash 標 deferred stub；每完成一段就 commit／push；線獎材料可能是 feature-pack 專屬名，勿假設只有 `slots.common`。

candidates.title: 2026-10-01 - Cap recovery loops; never reset the counter that gates them
candidates.summary: A recovery path that clears the same retry counter it is meant to advance will thrash forever; give failover a separate budget and prefer replace/requeue over `failed` for known-transient lobby errors.

candidates.title: 2026-09-09 - Well-known HTTP(S) ports may not fail named host resolve
candidates.summary: 擋裝置 OUTPUT 上常見的 HTTP／HTTPS port，**不能**當成已觸發 metadata 裡的 host-resolve Failed／Timeout 回呼。Success 仍可能接著連業務 TCP。

candidates.title: 載入 distributed runtime 鎖定機制、multi-agent 協調規則、async job 生命週期管理
candidates.summary: Distributed Runtime 定義 4 種分散式鎖（phase_transition、obligation_ledger、 generated_surface、transaction）含 lease time、retry policy、release condition； 6 條 multi-agent 協調規則（phase_check_before_action、generated_surface_version_check、 obligation_ledger_sync、transaction_isolation、phase_transition_exclusive、 stale_state_recovery）；5 個 async job 狀態（pending→running→completed/failed/cancelled） 含 allowed_transitions、timeout、retry_policy、dependency_check。

candidates.title: Evidence Model
candidates.summary: Evidence model 定義不同證據類型的可信度、覆蓋範圍與適用邊界。它不是測試清單，而是幫 agent 判斷「這個證據到底證明了哪一段」。

candidates.title: 新增或擴張 skill、workflow、rule、memory、context、automation 或 runtime surface 前，套用 five-step AI runtime governance
candidates.summary: Five-Step AI Governance 將 source philosophy 轉譯為新增 durable knowledge、context、memory、automation 和 runtime surface 前的 necessity/delete/simplify/accelerate/automation-last gate。

candidates.title: 2026-09-15 - Stale peer refused → refresh discovery; do not fail the job
candidates.summary: When a long-lived TCP peer returns `ECONNREFUSED` / host-unreachable, refresh the official discovery source, persist the new endpoint, and keep the durable job `running` instead of marking it failed.
